effects.printed_clause: Cannot be used as Xyz or Link Material, except for a Grayscale monster.
effects.lua_implementation: Uncopyable single effects prohibit Xyz and Link Material use whenever the destination monster is not in the Grayscale set.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses destination-qualified material restrictions together with archetype-limited summoning.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each following effect of Grayrover once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The hand summon, Link Summon, and GY revival effects use distinct id, id+100, and id+200 hard count keys.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses id-keyed turn limits across Special Summon and immediate Link Summon effects.

effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase, if your opponent controls a monster: Special Summon this card from your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A Main Phase hand Quick Effect checks for any opposing Monster, an open zone, and handler summon legality, then Special Summons the related card.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a Main Phase hand Quick Effect with opponent-field and self-Special-Summon checks.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned: immediately Link Summon a Grayscale Link Monster using materials you control and/or in your hand, including this card.
effects.lua_implementation: The delayed trigger temporarily registers EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL over the hand for every Monster Card, while extraval restricts the destination to Grayscale and requires this handler in the material group. The selected Grayscale Link Monster's own procedure determines which hand Monsters are otherwise legal; the temporary grant is reset after the Summon attempt.

effects.issue: Fixed: the hand-material grant no longer pre-filters to Grayscale LIGHT Fiends; any Monster in hand that the chosen Grayscale Link procedure legally accepts can now be used.

effects.printed_clause: If a Grayscale Xyz is Special Summoned to your field while this card is in your GY: discard 1, and if you do, Special Summon this card.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed GY field trigger detects a face-up controlled Grayscale Xyz in the event group, checks discard/zone/Necrovalley/summon legality, discards one during resolution, and only then revives the related handler.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a GY-range trigger with hand processing and a conditional self-Special Summon.
